description: Find resource / data source / ephemeral resource type names containing `query` (e.g. 's3_bucket') in the pinned providers. kind: resource | data | ephemeral.

dir.description: Terraform root module directory (must already be initialized). Default: TERRAFORM_CWD_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the type name

name: tf_search_types
